criteria.evidence: No deleted symbol is referenced under app, feature, core, tools or .github (git grep -w per symbol; only docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md mentions them). The gradle jobs (core/feature/app unit, lint, assemble, screenshots) were still pending at review time, and delivery-gates-pregate is red.

No light symbols remain in core/designsystem/src/main. The issue's literal grep 'isSystemInDarkTheme\|LightColors\|Manrope\|Archivo' core app feature still matches TmrThemeDarkOnlyTest.kt lines 26-32.

TmrThemeDarkOnlyTest.themeProvidesDarkColorsAtSystemLightMode runs at qualifiers notnight and asserts TmrDarkColors and DarkColorScheme; on the red commit TmrTheme defaulted to isSystemInDarkTheme() so it fails there. LocalTmrDark/isDark have no remaining use.

Both TTFs and both fonts-licenses/*-OFL.txt are deleted in the same commit; no OFL or fonts-licenses reference remains outside docs. typographyUsesDefaultFamily asserts FontFamily.Default (TmrFontFamilies.sans/display were Manrope/Archivo on the red base).
14 PNGs deleted; they belong to TmrComponentsScreenshotTest and TmrScreenLandscapeScreenshotTest, both deleted. No other module has baselines, so no surviving screen needs re-recording.

Deleted components have no consumer in app or feature. Kept files (TmrScreen, TmrSheet, TmrBottomActionBar, TmrDivider, TmrIconButton, HeaderBackdrop and others) are retained; TmrScreen is used only by the debug menu.
git diff base..head shows no change to theme/Motion.kt, component/TmrMotion.kt or theme/TmrMotionReducedTest.kt.
No tools:ignore, baselines added or ungrounded comments in the diff, but delivery-gates-pregate fails on the head with ASSERT_REMOVED, so the CI gate is not green.

findings.rule: 261-c8 / CI gate: pregate ASSERT_REMOVED needs a justification under '## Pre-review gate' in the PR body
findings.trigger: delivery-gates-pregate fails on efedc042 with ASSERT_REMOVED for TmrA11ySemanticsTest (-5), TmrBoundaryContrastTest (-2), TmrDisabledButtonTest (-2), TmrPaletteContrastTest (-7) and TmrStatusBarIconsTest (-5). The PR body still lists these five files under '## Lead test replacements (pending)' with no path-prefixed line in the Pre-review gate section, so is_justified() fails and the PR cannot merge.
findings.title: PR body lacks Pre-review gate justifications for the five light-case test edits; pregate check is red

findings.rule: Issue #261 acceptance criterion 2: grep -rn 'isSystemInDarkTheme\|LightColors\|Manrope\|Archivo' core app feature returns nothing
findings.trigger: Running the issue's grep on the head prints TmrThemeDarkOnlyTest.kt lines 26, 27, 30 and 32, because the banned-word list is written out as literals. The literal criterion therefore fails.
